data.description: Once per day, a taiga giant may perform a 10-minute ritual to tap into the power and insight of his ancestral spirits.  These spirits provide a +4 deflection bonus to AC, immunity to enchantment and illusion spells, and one of the following spell effects: bless, endure elements, protection from evil, protection from good, or see invisibility.  The effects of a spirit summoning persist for 24 hours.
data.name: Spirit Summoning
